Resolves #21215

🌿 The engine's dev server hands out files without installing a bundler's server.

`npm run server-start` now runs `buildScripts/util/fileServer.mjs`, a `node:http` server for the working directory, and `webpack-dev-server` leaves the engine: the lockfile goes from 542 entries to 385. `buildScripts/webpack/webpack.server.config.mjs` and its empty webpack entry `src/index.js` are deleted, the 14.0 clean cut (#21213, comment 6967621246). The theme freshness warning moves to `buildScripts/util/developmentThemeFreshness.mjs`.

Evidence: L2 (unit specs on the server, its flags and the spawned script; live runs on this checkout; two child-window e2e specs locally) → L3 required (the six tiers on this head, and their slowest engine step, from this PR's CI). Residual: AC-12, Residual-Owner: #21032.

## Deltas from ticket

- The server sits in `buildScripts/util/`, not `helpers/`. `classify-test-scope.yml` declares `buildScripts/helpers/` outside the e2e launch chain, and `util/` already holds this script's `preserver-start`.
- With neither `--port` nor `PORT`, the server takes 8080 and moves up past a taken port, as webpack-dev-server did. An explicit port that is taken fails.
- `create/component.mjs` starts the server by its path inside the engine, so it also works from a workspace.
- `run({open})` is the exported command-line entry. A generated workspace's `buildScripts/server.mjs` passes its app's route as data no shell parses (neomjs/create-app#72 keeps #74's rule), and a later `--open` or `--no-open` still wins. The entry traps no signals: the default ends the process.

- Live on this checkout: `/` 200 html; `/src/Neo.mjs` 200 `text/javascript`; `/examples/button/base` 301 to `/examples/button/base/`; `/.git/config` and `/.env` 404; `/dist/development/css/theme-neo-light/Global.css` 200 `text/css`; `Range: bytes=0-9` 206; `If-None-Match` 304. A second server on the same `--port` exits with "port 18431 is taken".
- AC-9: on this branch's server the dock tear-out example popped its Notes pane into `?tearout=notes`. That window loaded all 21 stylesheets (20 of them development theme sheets) with none unloaded, body background `rgb(13, 15, 18)`, font `"Source Sans 3", sans-serif`. `DockTearOutDefaultRoute.spec.mjs` passed 3/3.
- `WorkstationTwoRootsDragNL.spec.mjs` passed 5 of 6 on the first run. "one held gesture rejects B main and popup, then transfers into A popup once" failed once, a drag ending in `target-refused`. With `--repeat-each=3` it passed 3/3 on this branch and 3/3 on `dev` `d254125da4` (webpack-dev-server), so I count it as a flake. The CI shards are the larger sample.
